headline: Government announces double salary payment starts December 3
summary: The Dominican government will start paying RD$35,619 million in Christmas bonus salaries on December 3. Recipients include public servants, pensioners and armed and police forces, the national treasurer said.
why: Large state payouts inject cash into the economy and affect public spending and fiscal flows, which matter for consumption and government debt financing.
original_headline: Gobierno anuncia el pago del doble sueldo arranca el 3 de diciembre
